aria: Animated recap of the Grizzlies' 118 to 102 road win at Toronto: Jerami Grant's 3-pointer with 8:15 left, quarter-by-quarter scoring, Ty Jerome's 27 points, the top scorers, how the Grizzlies won, and the next game against Denver.
notes: Box score from the Grizzlies' 118–102 road win over the Toronto Raptors on Nov 9, 2026, from the Covers.com box score, with game details from the AP (via Yahoo Sports), The Sports Leader, TSN (The Canadian Press), Yahoo Sports, Yardbarker, BVM Sports and Raptors Republic. All 118 Grizzlies points and all 102 Raptors points are accounted for in the box score, and the quarter scores add up to both totals (59–53 at the half). Rebounds (44–34) are from the box score; TSN and BVM Sports say 45–34. Bench points (44–27) are summed from the box score and match Yahoo Sports; offensive rebounds (12–15) are from Yahoo Sports. The league stats feed wasn't available for this recap, so records come from the site's standings through Nov 8 plus Monday's results (Memphis 7–3 and 5–0 on the road, matching the AP and TSN; Denver 5–4).

Biggest leads: Memphis 16 and Toronto 6 (Covers; Toronto opened with the first six points, per The Sports Leader, and Yardbarker gives Memphis' 16). The note that Memphis has won five of its last six trips to Toronto and the snapped three-game losing streak are from the AP. The Grizzlies host Denver on Wednesday at 8:00 PM ET (Yardbarker).

The play of the game is an original illustration of Jerami Grant's 3-pointer with 8:15 left, which capped a 7–0 run and made it 101–92 (The Sports Leader) after Toronto opened the fourth on an 11–5 run to cut it to 94–92 (TSN, The Sports Leader). The recaps don't describe how he got the shot, so it is drawn as the template's plain pull-up. The figures are stylized and not traced from footage, and the spacing is not to scale.

The music is an original beat made for this page. No existing recordings or melodies are used. This is an unofficial fan recap, not affiliated with the Memphis Grizzlies or the NBA, which is why it carries a plain basketball mark and the team's colors but not the team's logo.

The shooter in the play of the game is drawn to Grant’s listed 6-foot-7 and 213 pounds (Basketball-Reference), with arms scaled to his 7-foot-2¾ wingspan at the 2014 draft combine (Top End Sports), in the Grizzlies' road kit. His No. 3 is from Basketball-Reference. He doesn't have an approved look on file yet, so he is drawn as a team-colour silhouette. It is an original silhouette with a featureless face, not a portrait or a trace of footage.
